evidence.title: Pango engineering hiring and ARR trajectory
evidence.rawVisibleText:
We’re looking to hire exceptional engineering interns at @Pango_ai  (YC S26) ASAP.

Pango is building the agentic operating system for e-commerce. Our platform allows merchants to create their own custom workflows to manage post-purchase logistics.

We are backed by Tier I investors and are rapidly scaling towards multi-million ARR.
You’ll work directly with the founding team on the core product and infrastructure as we expand into the US market.

We move extremely fast. We can make an offer within a week.

Details:
• Available to start ASAP and work through Aug & Sep
• Internship, with potential to convert to full-time
• Work in-person from our San Francisco hacker house with flights, accommodation & meals covered
• Competitive pay
• High ownership from day one

Join us in San Francisco during the YC batch and help us build the next unicorn.

Comment with why you are the right fit. We care less about credentials than your ability to build exceptional products and ship fast.
evidence.matchReason: Native Pango post by roster-linked founder Steve Rahimi.

evidence.title: Whitespace launches AI agents for wholesale distribution
evidence.rawVisibleText:
We're excited to launch @whitespacehqai on @ycombinator today!

Whitespace gives wholesale distributors AI agents that learn their business and do work across existing systems.

We’re already helping customers power the physical goods economy by automating inventory planning, customer service, and order processing.
evidence.matchReason: Native Whitespace launch post by roster-linked founder Alex Tung.

Should be a fun experiment.

evidence.title: Experiential Labs announces its digital-twin approach
evidence.rawVisibleText:
Excited to announce that I am co-founding @explabsai
with @OKfallah to solve continuous improvement in AI

AI still lacks the ability to learn from experiences, especially where data is difficult to acquire  

We build digital twins of production environments to solve this

That’s why we've been working on https://github.com/experientiallabs/world-model-harness  (⭐️ it)

Grateful to have the backing of @ycombinator and angels from NVIDIA, Meta Superintelligence Labs, Waabi, DeepMind, etc

More soon!
